rootCause: A code change in the latest release performs per-sensor queries, creating an N+1 pattern.

remediation.summary: Revert the release and deploy a batch-query implementation after verification.

executionSteps.intent: Restore the last healthy query behavior.
executionSteps.action: Roll back the affected service deployment to the last healthy revision.
executionSteps.successCriteria: Query volume per request and p99 latency return to their healthy ranges.

safeguards.preconditions: Confirm the latest deployment introduced the query regression and identify the last healthy revision.
safeguards.approval: Require the service owner or on-call SRE to approve the rollback.
safeguards.rollback: Stop or reverse the change if error rate or query latency increases.
safeguards.verification: Verify query volume, latency, and error rate across the configured observation window.
